instruction:
You are tasked with designing a module that takes in a clock signal (`clk`) and a reset signal (`rst`). The module should have an output register (`o_reg_example`) of 8 bits and an input register (`i_reg_example`) of 8 bits. 

The module should have a local parameter (`PARAM1`) set to a value of `32'h00000000`. You should also declare any necessary registers and wires.

The module should have both asynchronous and synchronous logic. 

The asynchronous logic should be triggered by the reset signal (`rst`) and should reset the output register (`o_reg_example`) to 0. 

The synchronous logic should be triggered by the positive edge of the clock signal (`clk`). The input register (`i_reg_example`) should be assigned to the output register (`o_reg_example`) on the positive edge of the clock signal (`clk`). 

Write a Verilog module that meets the above requirements.
